meta.title: Divided kingdoms
meta.era: Approx. after Solomon — Israel until 722 BCE; Judah continues later
meta.source: Digitized from media/historical/divided-kingdom.jpg (Knowing the Bible / USGS topography)
meta.disclaimer: Illustrative teaching overlays traced from the bundled atlas plate; borders are approximate and historically debated.
meta.georef: Affine georeference from Sea of Galilee / Dead Sea / coast control points (RMSE ~2 km). Negev folded into Judah. Aram and Phoenicia are cropped by the plate frame at ~34.0N and are extended north to ~34.5N (Phoenicia along the Lebanese coast). labelLng/labelLat drive the subtle map labels.
meta.smoothing: Colour-classified plate pixels, Gaussian-regularised label map, shared boundary arcs extracted once and smoothed with Douglas-Peucker + Chaikin so adjacent kingdoms share exact borders (no gaps/overlaps).
